caption: The drawing shows two glass bottles, each depicted with a blue tint, positioned side by side on a light beige background. Both bottles are of similar size and shape, featuring short necks and rounded shoulders, with the bases wider than the tops. The bottle on the left has an embossed design showing a flag, a cannon, and a pyramid in relief, suggesting symbolic imagery. The bottle on the right has “UNION” inscribed near the top in raised letters, along with an eagle above a shield; the shield contains stars and stripes, and below it are the words "FRANK" and a date, all surrounded by decorative foliage. The glass of both bottles is rendered with careful attention to reflections and transparency, highlighting their smooth surfaces and subtle blue-green coloration. Fine, small printed text in the bottom right corner reads “LOUIS WAINWRIGHT / KANSAS CITY - MO.”
title: Whiskey Bottle
